description.narrative: Det övergripande målet med projektet är att fungera som överbryggande finansiering för att bevara GoFors humankapital och stärka relationerna mellan LSU och GoFor för framställandet av en fullständig ansökan till Sida som möter ungdomars behov.

The project is to serve as a bridging fund to maintain human resources of Go-For and to build on the relations between LSU and Go-For to produce a successful full application to Sida to meet the needs of the youth field.

The overall objective of the project is to serve as a bridging fund to maintain human resources of Go-For and to build on the relations between LSU and Go-For to produce a successful full application to Sida to meet the needs of the youth field.
The project is structured around 1 Outcome and 2 Outputs.
Outcome 1: Professional relations between LSU and GoFor will be maintained and strengthened. New possibilities of new cooperations and a wider network between members organisations of LSU and GoFor will be achived.
Output 1: Full Application Folder
Output 2: Needs Assessment Report From the Field Visits
The project has delivered a full proposal to Sida and an agreement with GoFor has been signed on 01.06.2023. Planit ID: 16360A01 GoFor Expanding space for youth's political participation.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
